title: The First-tier Tribunal for Scotland Housing and Property Chamber (Procedure) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the First-tier Tribunal for Scotland Housing and Property Chamber (Procedure) Regulations 2017 (S.S.I. 2017/328) (“the principal Regulations”) to reflect the conferral of new functions on the First-tier Tribunal by sections 16 and 17 of the Housing (Scotland) Act 2025 (asp 13) (“the 2025 Act”). Section 14 of the 2025 Act gives local authorities and the Scottish Ministers powers to seek information from a landlord relating to the tenancy of a house included in the landlord’s entry in the landlord register. These Regulations make provision for an application to be made to the First-tier Tribunal by a local authority or the Scottish Ministers where an information holder fails to provide information without reasonable excuse, or provides information that the information holder must have known to be false in a material way.
